content:
olivia (oncall): :rotating_light: SLO p99 timeout spike in euw1 for Hosted Inference gateway. Alerts fired at 2024-06-02T14:23:xxZ. 5xx fraction jumped ~3x; multiple customer tickets (acme-corp, beta-api) reporting 504/502. Traces look sparse after 14:23 UTC — large trace gaps. Opening triage thread.

sam (sre): on it. which services are spiking? any recent deploys?

olivia (oncall): edge-proxy and prefetch-service show most of the 5xx. deploy-bot shows edge-proxy v2.13 to euw1 at 2024-06-02T14:15:02Z.

deploy-bot: Deployed edge-proxy v2.13 to euw1 at 2024-06-02T14:15:02Z by ci/cd-pipeline (#release/2024-06-02).

maria (support): customers include acme-corp (ticket #1234) — they sent curl that times out reliably. Payload small. They say retries also get 502s.

olivia (oncall): quick log query (datadog):
```
logs("service:edge-proxy env:prod status:[502 OR 504] | count() by http.url, status | rollup(sum, 1m)")
```
Results: spikes concentrated on `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embeddings` routes.

sam (sre): trying trace lookup for a failing trace id from acme sample: `trace_id=0x9b7f...` - lookup returns nothing after 14:24. Looks like sampling or trace-shipping failure coincident with spike.

kevin (infra): checking collector/otlp pipeline. There was a minor autoscaler event on collector instance group at 14:20 (scale up). I see transient backpressure on the exporter to traces-db around 14:22-14:26. Possible trace ingestion queue overflow.

sam (sre): that explains missing traces but not the 5xx source. Are the 5xx coming from upstream model servers or the gateway?

olivia (oncall): stack traces in edge-proxy logs show `context deadline exceeded` when waiting for prefetch-service KV lookup. Prefetch latencies jumped to 2s CDF tail.

maria (support): attached customer curl repro:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' --max-time 10
```
They see `504 Gateway Timeout`.

sam (sre): running a quick synthetic against euw1 `/v1/generate` from our internal probe pool. reproduces 504 with `upstream error: read tcp: connection reset by peer` in upstream connector.

kevin (infra): looking at prefetch-service pod metrics: heap pressure + KVCACHE eviction spikes at 14:18-14:24. There's a config change in v2.13 enabling aggressive keepalive that reduced connection reuse and increased backend churn.

olivia (oncall): hypothesis: deploy + keepalive change triggered KV cache thrash on prefetch, backend connections exhausted, gateway began timing out waiting on prefetch -> 5xx. Also trace pipeline backpressure caused missing spans.

sam (sre): agree. quick mitigation: roll edge-proxy keepalive flag back or scale prefetch-service and increase kvcache size. Can we patch keepalive off in euw1?

kevin (infra): can do rollback patch to revert keepalive behavior. Rolling config change to euw1 now (target 2m). Will also scale prefetch replicas by +2.

deploy-bot: Rolling config change: edge-proxy.keepalive=false to euw1 at 2024-06-02T14:33:12Z.

olivia (oncall): monitors show 5xx fraction falling within 4 minutes of rollback. SLO p99 heading back toward baseline. Customers responded that errors dropped.

maria (support): acme-corp confirms: error rate back to normal for them. Closing customer ticket pending postmortem.

sam (sre): next steps:
- create postmortem ticket and link to this thread (INC-2024-215).
- add a temporary alert to detect trace ingestion queue length > 50k to avoid silent trace gaps.
- add a canary check for keepalive toggle before broader rollout.

kevin (infra): logged infra action items: increase kvcache memory for prefetch-service in euw1, add graceful connection backoff for keepalive toggles, and add exporter autoscale thresholds.

olivia (oncall): I'm filing the incident now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2024-215. Assigning sam for postmortem, kevin for infra action items, maria to follow up with customers.

sam (sre): I'll take postmortem. Will add logs/queries used and timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria (support): thanks — will close customer tickets after final confirmation.

kevin (infra): monitoring to keep an eye for 1h, will report if anything recurs.

alertbot: Alert resolved: SLO p99 timeout spike in euw1 cleared at 2024-06-02T14:37:45Z.

olivia (oncall): Good triage. We'll capture rollout guard rails in the runbook and add a preflight check for trace pipeline headroom.
